messages.subject: Mensaje privado sobre: Mensaje privado sobre: I cannot download the asc files of my background
parts:
Hello, I explain you.

I introduce the occurrences and the bioclimatic variables. In the Process Environmental Data Component, I select study region using point buffers with 0.5 degrees and I select the default number of background points. When I try to save that background as ASCII, a new tab appears but the file is not downloaded, the same happens if I want to do it in GeoTIFF, it only lets me download shapefiles or .csv. In previous versions I used the same occurrence data and the same bioclimatic variables and yes I can download the background.

In R it appears from the beginning:
Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3507
Registered S3 methods overwritten by 'adehabitatMA':
  method                       from
  print.SpatialPixelsDataFrame sp  
  print.SpatialPixels          sp  
Warning: GEOS support is provided by the sf and terra packages among others
Warning: Error in zip_internal: Some files do not exist
  2: shiny::runApp
  1: run_wallace

Thanks in advance,

Best regards,

Claudia
